title.zh: 整体与其部分：不加前提的规律对每个世界成立，前提划出部分；活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现恰当止息复现，活跨越生起与止息，耗散使有限世界归于静止
title.en: The whole and its parts: the laws with no premise hold of every world and premises carve parts; in a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does, living crosses arising and ceasing, and dissipation brings a finite world to rest

claim.zh: 一个世界是以一类读法的关系项、其间的流与依存网（World）；空间是每个世界。两类读法的任一流与网都是一个世界，生起与止息在那里读法相同（World.ofRoles、arisingRecurs_ofRoles、ceasingRecurs_ofRoles）。Becoming.Change 的规律与 Becoming.Evolution 的算术恒等式（Price 方程的计数形式）不加关于展开的前提，对每个网与每个量陈述，所以对整个空间成立。读于部分：生起复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步生起，ArisingRecurs）与止息复现（某个关系项在任意晚的步止息，CeasingRecurs）在有限且活动可判定的世界中恰好同时成立（World.arising_iff_ceasing）。可判定性是这一规律自己的条件，不是表示的承诺：对每个有限世界都要求这一规律而不给可判定性，它就等价于排中律（World.law_iff_em，由 World.law_decides 与 World.law_of_em），在纯净核心中陈述，不需要选择公理。关系项无限多时，两者各可以没有另一个而复现（World.separate，由 Accretion 与 Attrition 给出），这些世界无限由该规律推出。活动需要支持、平衡、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用且只取用所汲取的、耗散、体现与承载活动的储备，每一个都有满足与不满足它的世界（World.contingent）：它们是前提，不是规律。有限世界中，生起复现与否，都既可以每个事件都活（逐步读法中不侵蚀），也可以有事件不活（World.living_crosses）；活动可判定时，止息复现与否也是如此（World.living_crosses_ceasing）：两侧来回传递一个水平（shuttle），同样的两侧另有一个吃草者把另一个关系项所依存的池汲低（grazing），始终活跃的互利者（mutualism），以及把池汲低的亲代（drawdown）。所以生起与止息都不决定事件是否活。grazing 的不活在对终结之步汲取承担自身者的判定之外，但被侵蚀的食草者在该步之后不活跃（World.grazing_browser_ends）：活动需要支持时，跨一步落到所需之下、以不低的所需持续的依存，属于在步后不活跃的形成（Web.Dependent.inactive_below），依存者原本活跃时，这是它的终结（Web.Dependent.ceases_below）；依存者休眠时没有任何终结：在 seedbank 中一个事件不活，而世界中从无止息（World.seedbank_world）；与依存者在该步之后不活跃同时的侵蚀是否计入不活、对哪些汲取者，由 Ren 选择。同样的活动而每侧汲取自身的水平（selfDrawing）也有不活的事件，但只在逐步读法对体现关系项终结之步自我汲取的判定之下，这一判定属于 Ren。在有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界中，生起与止息都不复现，不用判定程序（World.rests）；每个前提都不可少（World.rests_needs）：燃烧新燃料的世界以无限多关系项继续生起（throughput）；两侧来回传递，在没有耗散时继续生起（shuttle）；持有者每步取用自身一个单位而不给予，在没有平衡时继续生起，而它的耗散不空，两侧的家族每步封闭并被取用（leaking）；活动不是其水平的关系项在没有体现时继续生起（flicker），它从某步起不参与交换：有限、平衡且耗散的世界中取用不复现，所以任何这样的见证都如此。Ren 的“生成的”“退化的”指空间的哪些部分属于 Ren：本结果陈述活动的读法，生起复现与止息复现，二者在有限世界中重合，英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；作为关系，更新的形成与消耗的形成不重叠（Web.renewing_not_consuming）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。P58：静止不用判定程序。从某步起不上升的量，其下降从某步起停止不能被否证：并非此后每一步之后再有下降都不能被否证（falls_stop_unrefuted，由 still_le、unrefuted_falls_exceed；两种写法等价，stop_unrefuted_iff；它此后不变不能被否证，amount_still_unrefuted）。从某步起被平衡与耗散的家族中，体现的成员的生起从某步起停止不能被否证：并非此后每一步之后其中再有生起都不能被否证（Web.generation_stops_unrefuted）。有一个列表从某步起覆盖活跃者时，止息复现使此后每一步之后的生起都不能被否证（World.arising_unrefuted_covering，由 laws-of-one-step 的 Covers.not_not_coming_from），这一不能被否证的停止否证它；所以 World.rests_covering 与 World.rests 不要求活动可判定，名称不变，陈述更强。
claim.en: A world is its relata, read with one kind, with the flow among them and their web (World); the space is every world. The two-kind reading of any flow and web is a world, and arising and ceasing read the same there (World.ofRoles, arisingRecurs_ofRoles, ceasingRecurs_ofRoles). The laws of Becoming.Change and the arithmetic identity of Becoming.Evolution (the counting form of Price's equation) are stated of every web and every amount with no premise about the unfolding, so they hold throughout the space. Read of parts: arising recurring (some relatum arising at arbitrarily late steps, ArisingRecurs) and ceasing recurring (some relatum ceasing at arbitrarily late steps, CeasingRecurs) hold together exactly in every finite world whose activity is decided (World.arising_iff_ceasing). Decidedness is this law's own condition, not a commitment of the representation: asked of every finite world without it, the law is equivalent to excluded middle (World.law_iff_em, from World.law_decides and World.law_of_em), stated in the pure core with no choice. With infinitely many relata either can recur without the other (World.separate, from Accretion and Attrition), and that these worlds are infinite follows from the law. Activity needing support, balance, only active relata giving, only active relata taking and only what they draw on, dissipation, embodiment and a reserve carrying activity are each met by some worlds and not by others (World.contingent): they are premises, not laws. Among finite worlds, arising recurring or not occurs both with every event living, not undermining in the stepwise reading, and with some event not living (World.living_crosses), and with activity decided so does ceasing recurring or not (World.living_crosses_ceasing): two sides handing one standing back and forth (shuttle), the same sides with a grazer drawing down a pool another relatum depends on (grazing), mutualists active throughout (mutualism), and a parent drawing a pool down (drawdown). So neither arising nor ceasing decides whether events are living. grazing's verdict lies outside the verdict about drawing on a self-bearing relatum at its own ending, but the browser it undermines is not active after that step (World.grazing_browser_ends): where activity needs support, a dependence left below its need and persisting at no lower need belongs to a formation not active after the step (Web.Dependent.inactive_below), where that formation was active this is its ending (Web.Dependent.ceases_below), and where it was dormant nothing ends: in seedbank an event is not living while nothing in the world ever ceases (World.seedbank_world); whether undermining that co-occurs with the relatum depending not being active after the step counts against living, and for which drawers, is Ren's to choose. The same activity while each side draws on its own standing (selfDrawing) also has an event that is not living, but only on the stepwise reading's verdict about drawing on a self-bearing embodied relatum at its ending, which is Ren's to choose. In a finite, balanced, dissipative world in which whatever arises is embodied, neither arising nor ceasing recurs, with no decision procedure (World.rests), and each premise is needed (World.rests_needs): a world burning fresh fuel keeps arising with infinitely many relata (throughput); two sides handing a standing keep arising without dissipation (shuttle); the holder taking its own unit and giving nothing keeps arising without balance, with non-vacuous dissipation, the family of both sides closed and taken from at every step (leaking); and a relatum whose activity is not its standing keeps arising without embodiment (flicker), taking part in no exchange from some step on, as any such witness must, since taking does not recur in a finite, balanced, dissipative world. Which parts of the space Ren's ‘generative’ and ‘degenerative’ name is Ren's to choose: this result states the reading of activity, arising recurring and ceasing recurring, which coincide in finite worlds, with names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); read as relations, renewing and consuming formations do not overlap (Web.renewing_not_consuming). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. P58: rest needs no decision procedure. For an amount that does not rise from some step on, that its falls stop from some step on cannot be refuted: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later fall stays unrefuted (falls_stop_unrefuted, from still_le and unrefuted_falls_exceed; the two forms are equivalent, stop_unrefuted_iff; that it stays the same from some step on cannot be refuted, amount_still_unrefuted). In a family balanced and dissipated on from some step on, that the arising of the embodied members stops from some step on cannot be refuted: it is not the case that after every step from then on a later arising of one of them stays unrefuted (Web.generation_stops_unrefuted). With a list covering what is active from some step on, ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step (World.arising_unrefuted_covering, from Covers.not_not_coming_from of laws-of-one-step), which the unrefuted stopping refutes; so World.rests_covering and World.rests need no decided activity, their names unchanged and their statements stronger.

hypotheses.zh: 规律（arising_iff_ceasing）：世界有限，即有一个不重复地列出全部关系项的列表；每步每个关系项是否活跃是可判定的。可判定性是这一规律自己的条件，不是表示的承诺，经典地总是成立；对每个有限世界都要求这一规律而不给它，它就等价于排中律（law_iff_em）。
hypotheses.en: The law (arising_iff_ceasing): the world is finite, a list naming every relatum once; whether each relatum is active at each step is decidable. Decidedness is this law's own condition, not a commitment of the representation, classically always met; asked of every finite world without it, the law is equivalent to excluded middle (law_iff_em).

hypotheses.zh: 静止（rests）：另加平衡（Balanced）、耗散（Dissipative）与生起者体现（ArisingEmbodied）；不要求活动可判定（P58）。
hypotheses.en: Rest (rests): also balance (Balanced), dissipation (Dissipative) and whatever arises being embodied (ArisingEmbodied); activity need not be decided (P58).

hypotheses.zh: 其余都是关于具体世界的陈述，不加前提；law_decides 以那一规律对每个有限世界成立为假设。
hypotheses.en: The rest are statements about particular worlds, with no premise; law_decides takes the law for every finite world as its hypothesis.

hypotheses.zh: law_of_em 以排中律为假设（定理的假设，不是公理），不要求可判定性。
hypotheses.en: law_of_em takes excluded middle as a hypothesis (of the theorem, not an axiom) and needs no decidability.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的原话（2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority）：“when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0”。计划 P22 把这读作：规律对整个空间成立，前提划出部分。作者的读法（AI 论证）：本结果给出这一提议的一种结构。整体是每个世界；不加关于展开的前提的规律（变化的规律、算术恒等式，以及活动可判定的有限世界中生起与止息的同时复现）对整体成立；各定理的前提每一个都划出真部分，不是隐藏的规律。Ren 在 2026-10-09 说：“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”（2026-10-09-renewing-consuming-without-axioms）。所以本结果不把生起复现与止息复现称为生成的与退化的部分：二者在有限世界中重合；作为关系，更新的形成与消耗的形成不重叠（Web.renewing_not_consuming），同一事件可以参与二者。提议中的“生成的、退化的”取哪种读法属于 Ren（第九次独立审查 M1）。Ren 说加上公理可以定义好，“好”是整个空间的一部分；这里的 Living 是逐步读法中“每个事件都活”的结构条件，是 G0 所计的 living 的一个部分，它跨越生起与止息，不与其中任何一个重合：生起不是活的同义词，止息也不是不活。这不证明整个生成之论不需要任何公理：它显示哪些陈述不需要前提、哪些前提划出哪些部分；“不加实质公理的整体演绎必然性”仍是开放的首要目标。“世界”“生起复现”“止息复现”是 AI 的表述，名称由 Ren 定。
correspondence.en: Ren's words (2026-10-08-theory-of-becoming-priority): ‘when we add axiom, we can define what is good, which is a part of the whole space generative model projects / but, if we count all space, generative, degenerative, we get The theory of evolution, or the theory of becoming/life, which doesn't even require axiom, i think can be done with 0’. Plan P22 reads this as: the laws hold of the whole space, and premises carve parts. The author's reading (an AI argument): this result gives one structure for that proposal. The whole is every world; the laws with no premise about the unfolding (the laws of change, the arithmetic identity, and arising and ceasing recurring together in finite worlds whose activity is decided) hold of the whole; each premise of the theorems carves a proper part and is not a hidden law. On 9 October Ren said: ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’ (2026-10-09-renewing-consuming-without-axioms). So this result does not call arising recurring and ceasing recurring the generative and degenerative parts: they coincide in finite worlds, while read as relations renewing and consuming formations do not overlap (Web.renewing_not_consuming), though one event can take part in both. Which reading the proposal's ‘generative, degenerative’ takes is Ren's to choose (ninth independent review, M1). Ren says that with an axiom we can define the good as a part of the whole space; Living here is the structural condition that every event is living in the stepwise reading, one part of what G0 counts as living, and it crosses arising and ceasing without coinciding with either: arising is not a synonym for living, and ceasing is not not-living. This does not prove that the theory of becoming needs no axiom at all: it shows which statements need no premise and which premises carve which parts; the deductive necessity of the whole without added substantive axioms remains the open first priority. ‘World’, ‘arising recurring’ and ‘ceasing recurring’ are the AI's formulations, and names are Ren's.

detail.zh: 复用止息（Ceases）、形成有限多时生起不息恰当止息不息（unceasing_iff）与 Accretion、Attrition。
detail.en: Reuses ceasing (Ceases), that with finitely many formations arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is (unceasing_iff), and Accretion and Attrition.

output.zh: 形成有限多且活动可判定时，生起不息恰当止息不息；Accretion 与 Attrition 各只有一方。
output.en: With finitely many formations and activity decided, arising is unceasing exactly when ceasing is; Accretion and Attrition each have only one.

input.zh: 活动可判定的有限世界中生起复现恰当止息复现；无限世界中两者分离，且其无限由此推出。
input.en: In a finite world whose activity is decided arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; in infinite worlds they separate, and their infinity follows.

detail.zh: 复用 generation_ceases 与 Shuttle、Throughput、Flicker 三个见证。
detail.en: Reuses generation_ceases and the witnesses Shuttle, Throughput and Flicker.

output.zh: 有限的关系项、平衡与耗散之下，体现的关系项不在任意晚的步生起。
output.en: With finitely many relata, under balance and dissipation, embodied relata do not arise at arbitrarily late steps.

input.zh: 有限、平衡、耗散且生起者体现的世界归于静止；每个前提都不可少。
input.en: A finite, balanced, dissipative world whose arising is embodied comes to rest; each premise is needed.

conditions.zh: 平衡；耗散；有限；生起者体现。

detail.zh: 复用一类读法（roles 与其迁移引理）、体现与 Mutualism。
detail.en: Reuses the one-kind reading (roles and its transfer lemmas), embodiment and Mutualism.

output.zh: 两类读法嵌入一类读法，生起不息在其中不变；互利者的每个事件都活；Shuttle 的两侧来回传递一个水平。
output.en: The two-kind reading embeds in the one-kind reading, keeping unceasing arising; every event of the mutualists is living; the sides of Shuttle hand one standing back and forth.

input.zh: 每个两类的流与网都是一个世界；有限世界中，生起不复现而每个事件都活；grazing 与 leaking 以 Shuttle 为基础。
input.en: Every two-kind flow and web is a world; a finite world without arising recurring in which every event is living; grazing and leaking build on Shuttle.

detail.zh: 复用储备（Carries）、零储备恰是 Dependent（carries_zero）与 Carries.active_finitely。
detail.en: Reuses the reserve (Carries), that Dependent is exactly the zero reserve (carries_zero), and Carries.active_finitely.

output.zh: 从某步起不被支持的形成只活跃有限多次。
output.en: A formation unsupported from some step on is active only finitely often.

input.zh: 每步都超出支持而活跃的关系项没有任何储备承载它。
input.en: No reserve carries a relatum active beyond its support at every step.

output.zh: 亲代的取用把池汲低；超出支持的亲代。
output.en: A parent's taking draws a pool down; a parent beyond its support.

input.zh: 有限世界中，生起不复现且有事件不活；活动需要支持的反例。
input.en: A finite world without arising recurring in which some event is not living; a countermodel to activity needing support.

detail.zh: 复用更新与消耗的形成（RenewingIn、ConsumingIn）及二者不重叠（renewing_not_consuming）。
detail.en: Reuses renewing and consuming formations (RenewingIn, ConsumingIn) and that they do not overlap (renewing_not_consuming).

output.zh: 更新的形成不是消耗的形成。
output.en: A renewing formation is not a consuming one.

input.zh: Ren 的“生成的、退化的”的关系读法，作为与活动读法并列的候选。
input.en: The relational reading of Ren's ‘generative, degenerative’, a candidate beside the reading of activity.

detail.zh: 局部规律复用 laws-of-one-step 的 Flow.BalancesOn。
detail.en: The local laws reuse Flow.BalancesOn of laws-of-one-step.

input.zh: 本记录的局部规律在所用的步与家族上用它。
input.en: This record's local laws use it at the steps and families they use.

detail.zh: 完成计划第 9 节下的 P22：规律对整体成立，前提划出部分；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Completes P22 under the plan's section 9: the laws hold of the whole and premises carve parts; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: Living 是逐步读法中每个事件都活（活跃且不侵蚀）的结构条件。
detail.en: Living is the structural condition that every event is living in the stepwise reading, active and not undermining.

detail.zh: 那里一步之内上升与下降的伴随，这里是整个空间中生起与止息的同时复现。
detail.en: There, a rise accompanied by a fall within one step; here, arising and ceasing recurring together across the space.

detail.zh: 有限世界的规律在不要求可判定时的形式：止息永不终止、生起永不终止，以及从某步起已定时的规律。
detail.en: The forms of the law for finite worlds without decidedness: ceasing never stopping for good, arising never stopping for good, and the law where decided from some step on.

detail.zh: 无限多关系项时生起与止息分离（Accretion、Attrition）；rests 的每个前提缺少时生起可以复现（throughput、shuttle、leaking、flicker），leaking 的耗散不空；grazing 不依赖自我汲取的判定而有不活的事件；undecided 显示有限世界的规律需要可判定性。
detail.en: With infinitely many relata arising and ceasing separate (Accretion, Attrition); without any one premise of rests arising can recur (throughput, shuttle, leaking, flicker), leaking with non-vacuous dissipation; grazing has an event that is not living without the verdict on self-drawing; undecided shows that the finite-world law needs decidability.

detail.zh: seedbank：有限、平衡、每个关系项体现、活动需要支持；汲取者的事件侵蚀休眠种子持续不变的依存，事件不活，inactive_below 的前提成立，而种子从不活跃，世界中从无止息：侵蚀不必与终结同时（第十一次独立审查 R1）。
detail.en: seedbank: finite, balanced, every relatum embodied, activity needing support; the drawer's event undermines a dormant seed's unchanged dependence and is not living, and the premises of inactive_below hold, yet the seed is never active and nothing in the world ever ceases: undermining need not co-occur with an ending (the eleventh independent review's R1).

limitations.zh: 不含伦理谓词，不评价任何部分；不证明整个生成之论不需要公理；Living 只是逐步读法的结构条件，不是 G0 的估值本身；有限世界的规律要求活动可判定，对每个有限世界要求而不给可判定性时它等价于排中律；只对离散步的读法陈述；部分的列举不完全：前提的组合与更多的部分（例如更多、可能性的上升）没有逐一给出；Ren 的“生成的”“退化的”指哪些部分由 Ren 定，本结果只陈述活动的读法；名称由 Ren 定。
limitations.en: Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates no part; does not prove that the theory of becoming needs no axiom; Living is only the structural condition of the stepwise reading, not G0's valuation itself; the law for finite worlds needs decidable activity, and asked of every finite world without it is equivalent to excluded middle; stated for the reading across discrete steps; the parts listed are not exhaustive: combinations of premises and further parts, such as more or the rise of possibility, are not each given; which parts Ren's ‘generative’ and ‘degenerative’ name is Ren's to choose, and this result states only the reading of activity; names are Ren's.
